g.text: APPLE, M3 AND LATER (DYNAMIC CACHING): REGISTERS, THREADGROUP, TILE AND STACK ARE ALLOCATED ON DEMAND FROM ONE ON-CORE CACHE POOL
GLOBAL MEMORY (HBM DRAM, 40 GB, ~1.6 TB/S) - GPU-ONLY
CPU + HOST RAM: A SEPARATE POOL, EVERY BYTE CROSSES PCIE
GPU LAST-LEVEL CACHE (L2, SMALL - NO 40 MB SAFETY NET)
SYSTEM LEVEL CACHE (SLC, TENS OF MB - SHARED WITH CPU + ANE)

text.tspan: UNIFIED MEMORY (LPDDR - ONE POOL FOR CPU AND GPU.
